tailoring.headline: Senior SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java & OCC REST APIs
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms using SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) 2105 and 2211 for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL, database performance tuning, and PIM/ERP integrations. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and agile teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.
keywords_missing: Salesforce or other non-SAP CX platforms

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior SAP CX Consultant (all genders)
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Senior SAP CX Consultant position at adesso SE. With over 5 years of professional experience specializing in SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) development at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise in enterprise e-commerce solutions.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Expertise
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing, and customer data management.

bullets.label: API & Integration
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and customized Interceptors, Populators, and Converters for custom data flows and headless integrations.

bullets.label: Enterprise Data Flows
bullets.text: Designed, built, and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub to keep product catalogs synchronized across global channels.

bullets.label: DevOps & Delivery
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) within agile DevOps workflows while supporting production troubleshooting.

cover_en.gap: While my primary focus is deep technical back-end delivery and SAP Commerce Cloud implementation rather than broader cross-module CX suite consulting, I am highly motivated to expand my consulting and advisory capabilities within your team.
cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German residence and work permit without requiring sponsorship, and am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026, enabling an earliest start date of 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my background aligns with your projects.

tailoring.why_company: I want to work at adesso SE because of its strong reputation for delivering complex digital business solutions and enterprise consulting in the DACH region. I am eager to apply my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud expertise in challenging customer projects while collaborating with international agile teams.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud expertise, robust Java backend skills, and enterprise integration experience to drive successful e-commerce delivery at adesso SE.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I am a Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I noticed your opening for a Senior SAP CX Consultant at adesso SE and would love to connect to discuss how my Java and Hybris background can add value.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Senior SAP CX Consultant (all genders) - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application documents, including my CV and cover letter, for the Senior SAP CX Consultant position at adesso SE. With over 5 years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience across Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong expertise in Java, Spring, and enterprise integrations. I hold a valid German work permit and can join starting 16.12.2026. I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
